headline: Non-executive director acquires 50,000 units on market
summary: A non-executive director purchased 50,000 units at $2.18 per unit, increasing their total holding to 410,000 units. This is a routine director interest notice.

headline: $85m placement to fund $120m Northshore Clinics acquisition
summary: Coralwave Health raises $85m at a 9.5% discount to acquire 14 day-surgery clinics for $120m. The acquisition is expected to be EPS accretive in its first full year.

headline: FY27 copper guidance cut after pit wall failure closes mine
summary: Pit wall failure at Kestrel mine closes main haul road for ~8 weeks, reducing FY27 copper production guidance and raising AISC by 12%. No injuries. Remediation underway; update at quarterly report in January.

headline: Half-year revenue up 31%, first positive operating cash flow
summary: Revenue grew strongly to $48.2m with ARR at $112m. The company achieved its first positive operating cash flow of $3.1m. Full-year guidance remains unchanged, signaling management confidence.

headline: CEO resigns after six years; search for successor underway
summary: The CEO has resigned effective 31 January 2027. The board is searching for a successor internally and externally. The CFO will serve as interim CEO if no successor is appointed by the effective date, creating leadership uncertainty.

headline: All resolutions passed at Annual General Meeting
summary: Shareholders approved all resolutions at the AGM. Routine governance matter with no unexpected outcomes.
